name: Raymond Multipurpose Rack
description: 3-tier stackable plastic multipurpose rack with apple-pattern ventilation. Durable, lightweight and ideal for kitchen, bathroom or home organisation.
details: The Raymond Multipurpose Rack by Ruby Plastic is a practical 3-tier stackable storage solution. Made from strong plastic with decorative apple-shaped ventilation holes for better air circulation. The open-front design allows easy access to items. Lightweight yet durable, it is perfect for organising kitchen essentials, toiletries, toys or household items. Can be used as a single unit or stacked as needed. Suitable for any home in Sri Lanka.
